Types

Span = tuple[text: string, code: string]
One colored fragment for the display procs (kapsis-style, without the termstyle dependency). code "" renders plain. 
Spinner = object
  running*: bool

Consts

versionStr = "0.1.5"
Binary version, always from carne.nimble (compile-time, so the CLI, help text and std tag resolution can never drift).

proc cmdHelp(cmd, comment: string) {....raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
One command row for the usage screens: two-space indent, comment column at 28. Adding a command is one line; flags hang off it via flagHelp below. 
proc confirm(question: string): bool {....raises: [IOError],
                                       tags: [WriteIOEffect, ReadIOEffect],
                                       forbids: [].}
y/N prompt, default no. False when stdin is not a TTY or on EOF, so scripts and pipes never confirm destructively.

proc resolveTestArg(arg: string; root = "tests"): string {....raises: [],
    tags: [ReadDirEffect], forbids: [].}
File-only resolution for carne test <arg>. Tries the arg as given, then under root, then .test.js variants. Returns "" when nothing exists. 
proc span(text: string; code = ""): Span {....raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Builds one display fragment (code "" for plain text). 
proc spansToStr(xs: openArray[Span]): string {....raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Renders fragments back to back (callers embed their own spaces). Empty codes pass through untouched (no stray reset sequences). 
proc spinnerActive(): bool {....raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
True while a spinner animates on this process. 
proc startSpinner(msg: string): Spinner {....raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Animates msg on a TTY. Idle otherwise (callers fall back to plain log lines, which the datpkgr callback already emits). 
proc stopSpinner(s: var Spinner) {....raises: [IOError], tags: [WriteIOEffect],
                                   forbids: [].}
Stops the animation and erases the spinner row. 
proc useColor(): bool {....raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
TTY-gated, unless the CLI --isatty flag says otherwise. No env vars: color control lives at the CLI level.

Templates

template withSpinner(msg: string; body: untyped): untyped
Runs body while msg animates on a TTY (plain log lines otherwise). Exceptions propagate after the spinner stops.
